atlases.name: lunar-guide
atlases.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production PNG sprite atlas for the Traditional Chinese cinematic divination website 靜月之光.
Primary request: create ONE original premium semi-realistic East Asian fantasy cinematic game character in exactly FOUR separate waist-up poses, arranged in exactly four equally sized, equally spaced columns from left to right.
Canvas/composition: landscape 2048 x 1024 pixels, four invisible cells of 512 x 1024 pixels. Transparent background with real PNG alpha; background and gaps must be fully transparent, not a picture of transparency. Every character pose fits wholly inside its own quarter with 6% interior margin; no limb, hair or garment may cross the invisible column boundaries. All four heads share the same top height and identical body scale. Keep the entire head, hair, hands, elbows and waist in every cell. No frames or visible panel divisions.
Pose order, left to right: 0 greeting, eyes open, hands relaxed; 1 meditating/listening, eyes gently closed, palms together; 2 ritual activation, one palm extended forward at waist level, eyes looking down toward that palm; 3 revealing/inviting, eyes open with a slight warm smile, one hand gesturing to the side but fully inside its own cell.
Style and quality: exquisite appealing East Asian face, anatomically accurate graceful hands, natural human proportions, warm approachable presence, rich silk texture and extremely fine embroidery, cinematic dramatic rim light. The same original face, hair and clothing in all four poses, visually consistent and production-ready.
Constraints: original designs, no resemblance to a known franchise, modest nonrevealing attire, no weapons, no large props obscuring the face. No text, numbers, labels, watermarks, UI, background scenery, frames, floor, cast shadows beneath the subject, checkerboard or white/black opaque backdrop. Preserve true alpha transparency.
Subject: an elegant female lunar guide in her late 20s, long flowing black hair, delicate crescent filigree hairpiece. Midnight navy silk robe with fine antique gold astronomical embroidery and a modest ivory inner neckline. Lighting: warm gold highlights with cool moonlit edges.
